units.source_text: 也许老师会冷不防地来到我的房间，宽恕我了吧？

en.t: Perhaps the teacher would come unexpectedly to my room and forgive me.

units.source_text: 我被宽恕，也许会有生以来头一遭像鹤川的日常那样，到达无瑕的明朗的感情。

en.t: Forgiven, I might for the first time in my life reach a flawless, bright feeling like Tsurukawa's everyday state of mind.

units.source_text: 老师与我大概会互相拥抱、会叹息相互理解太晚了吧。

en.t: The teacher and I would probably embrace each other and sigh that we had understood one another too late.

units.source_text: 无疑，惟有这一点保留了下来。

en.t: Without doubt, only this one thing remained.
